verdicts.reason: A keeps the tagline on one readable line with the koala as a left-hand anchor, but the koala is shrunk to a near-unrecognisable thumbnail and a stray fragment of roses floats at the top centre with no purpose, so the hero illustration is effectively lost. B is broken: the tagline wraps awkwardly ('short / wear') and runs into the pale blue circle, which hides part of 'clothes'; the koala and a detached rose fragment are tiny, scattered specks in the middle; and the left half is dead space.
